invariants: zero, empty string, empty list, null, missing and unavailable are never collapsed by truthy fallback
production adapters do not invent IP addresses, identifiers, counts, trends, topology or business rows
a frontend list cannot be promoted into a production graph, KPI or relationship fact
live responses never fall back to fixture data and simulation remains explicitly labeled
legacy field aliases and pagination parameters are explicit versioned mappings with an owner and usage telemetry
domain.compensation: restore the prior typed adapter artifact while retaining every route, field, control and operation; never restore prohibited demo fill into a write path

data.migration: typed response expansion precedes removal of internal guessing; no external field is removed in this program

negative_tests: explicit zero remains zero when non-empty child arrays exist
missing topology or source IP renders unavailable and never a hard-coded private address
mock-disabled live response cannot import runtime fixture values

stop_conditions: adapter-derived value differs from the contract field or hides an unavailable source

tests: G0 adapter inventory and no-new-risk ratchet
G1 typed zero empty missing and partial unit tests
G2 fixture/live schema diff against real pilot services
G3 sampled displayed value to source fact reconciliation
G5 Windows Chrome mock-off missing-source rendering
G6 canary rollback without removed compatibility surface
evidence: production bundle, HAR and trace show no fixture fallback, hard-coded business fact or silent inferred value for the sampled pilot fields
